comment: European coverage among the country and regional illustrations is thin. Appendix D includes Spain (Catalonia) at subnational level, England in relation to pharmaceutical decision support, and an EU/EEA entry on regional surveillance, but there is no example of a national-level implementation in an EU Member State operating under the EU regulatory framework (GDPR, EHDS) — which is the setting most relevant to readers planning adoption in Europe.

public.text: European coverage among the country and regional illustrations is thin. Appendix D includes Spain (Catalonia) at subnational level, England in relation to pharmaceutical decision support, and an EU/EEA entry on regional surveillance, but there is no example of a national-level implementation in an EU Member State operating under the EU regulatory framework (GDPR, EHDS) — which is the setting most relevant to readers planning adoption in Europe.
public.suggestedRevision: Add at least one national-level European example, such as Italy's Fascicolo Sanitario Elettronico (FSE 2.0) or MyHealth@EU, to illustrate how DPI-H principles translate into practice within the EU regulatory and infrastructural context, alongside the existing subnational and regional entries.
